ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 88% high-intensity (white) pixels to 12% low-intensity (black/dark-textured) pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous high-intensity white region across both lobes; thin, irregular low-intensity black band along the trailing edge boundary; high-entropy textured clusters (brown/gold/white) concentrated at the distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 65-70 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 20% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, coarse serration; irregular pixel-amplitude peaks (5-20 pixels) and valleys distributed along the black trailing edge boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a downward slope towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, textured high-relief pixels (barnacles) at the far left and far right distal margins; localized circular pitting marks on the interior surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant epibiotic (barnacle) colonization concentrated on the lateral tips; distinct circular surface depressions (pitting) on the central-left lobe area.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high white pigmentation coverage (>95% of central lobe area) with minimal focal mottling.
